text: A request for 1–30 seats and a nonblank course code is accepted once per business key; the instructor sees only their requests.
criteria: Repeated REQ-A yields one business request; invalid seats or another instructor's status query are rejected.

text: Allocation and manifest tasks execute in order with stable per-request identities; task retry cannot create a second workspace/manifest.
criteria: Retry allocation after commit; one workspace and one manifest identity remain bound to the request.

text: Explicit evaluator outcomes select accepted branches; unknown outcomes use a reviewed failure default rather than accidental success.
criteria: Execute ALLOW, DENY, READY, FAILED and unknown outcomes; the graph follows documented branches/default.

text: Retain the original request and each required task result; terminal success requires successful readiness verification.
criteria: Inspect each task input/history; instructor/course/allocated workspace remain present and success follows verification only.

text: A failed execution is visible with its last completed task and can be resumed/retried through an authorized, idempotent recovery design.
criteria: Recover a failed manifest step; reuse allocation and retain both failed and recovery execution references.

text: With a five-second configured wait, 20 nominal requests complete within 60 seconds each; record actual task/execution history.
criteria: Execute 20 requests with the configured wait and retain measured histories/latencies.
